decisions.reason: The source changes wording and timing for the post-mint modal, not the About page content.
The source specifies a post-distribution success message, whereas this Requirement governs referral-code validity and pre-mint valid or invalid feedback.
Mention of the book title is incidental; the source does not change certificate delivery, contents, or reading actions.
The source explicitly targets modal copy and does not request any corresponding FAQ revision.
The modal text references the existing $5 commission and $500 ticket but does not alter mint pricing or revenue allocation.
Random distribution of the no-referral commission is already required; the source only conditions when and how the completed distribution is described in the modal.
The source does not change ticket counting, recipient crediting, backfill, or display consistency rules.
The existing Requirement already assigns one no-referral ticket to a random existing holder; the source changes only the success feedback shown after that allocation.
The source does not address fiat wallet creation, custody, access, or confirmation-email behavior.
The source concerns a mint with no referral code and does not change commission behavior for code-used mints.
The source does not mention or modify tipping options, transactions, or disclosures.
The source specifies modal copy and timing but does not change NFT metadata fields or reward-accounting attributes.
